style: The agency set as the index at the back of a well-made book: Libre Caslon on cream stock (or warm black), rubric red locators, dotted leaders, a side card that turns to the page an entry points at and a running folio.

concept.idea: A general agency's problem is breadth: it does many things, and visitors need to find theirs. So the site is an index of capabilities. Every service, discipline, step and term is an entry with a locator, and the sections below are the pages those locators point to.
concept.signature: Pointing at or tabbing to an index entry slides a red thumb tab into its margin, runs its dotted leader and turns the side card to that entry's page: the locator set large in red, its title and its description. A running folio names the section being read. On a phone the index is a plain list of links; without JS the card shows how to read the index.

jury.note: Self-score from the /jury rubric and shoot.mjs evidence (0 axe violations, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440 with the sample and with long.json, no tap target under 24 px, skip link first and every focus stop visible, no colour-only primary hover, nothing moving under reduced motion). No blind critic was run for this batch. The idea is specific to a general agency (breadth made findable) and the index, leaders, turning side card and thumb tabs agree with each other. Calm by design, so the first frame relies on type more than on a moment; the side card and thumb tabs are desktop-only, and on a phone the index is a plain list of links.
